Name: Warp Totems to Magic Book Tomes
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][i][color=#f9cb9c]Turns Warp Totems into magical book tomes, perfect for adding more magical vibe into your game! [/color][/i][/font][/size][/center]

[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#f9cb9c]This mod retextures:[/color][/b][/font][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Warp Totems[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Weather Totem[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Treasure Totem[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#f9cb9c][b]Comes with support for expansions:[/b][/color][/font][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Stardew Valley Expanded[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Ridgeside VIllage[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]East Scarp[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Cape Stardew[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Mineral Town﻿[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Durin's Rest[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Aurora Vineyard travel pack[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][line]

[url=https://postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t/config-options.png[/img][/url]

[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Choose between two book designs: Emblem or Golden Frame.[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Toggle each totem's retexture individually by config.[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Customize the bookmark ribbon color.[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#f9cb9c]Available colors:[/color][/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#cc0000]Red[/color][/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#00ff00]Green[/color][/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#00ffff]Cyan[/color][/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#ffffff][b]Custom*[/b][/color][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][b][u][size=3]*You can сreate your own ribbon color by manually editing the sprite:[/size][/u][/b][/font]

[list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Go to Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Warp Totems to Magic Book Tomes\assets folder[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Find png files named:[/font][/size]
[code]"bookmark_vanilla_custom"
"bookmark_modded_custom"
"bookmark_misc_custom"[/code][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Open them in any image editor and change color of the texture to your desired one[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Save the image[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Open the game and set "Bookmark Ribbon Color" to "Custom"[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Done![/font][/size][/*]
[/list][line]

[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#f9cb9c]Credits:[/color][/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Book sprites are from [url=http://www.kindpng.com/imgv/hiiTJx_rpg-items-pixel-art-pixel-art-rpg-items/]free RPG sprite sheet[/url] (I slightly recolored them and added emblems).
[url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194104024-aztecviper/]AztecViper[/url] made retextures for Treasure Totem, Wind Totem (SVE) and Cape Stardew Totem.[/font][/size][/center]
